text:
Ilse Marrenkamp has been appointed chief executive of Varnholt Logistics, the company confirmed on Thursday.

The appointment took effect on 14 March, following a board vote the previous evening. Marrenkamp takes over a company with 6,200 employees and annual revenue of €1.8 billion.

Tobias Wennerlund, chair of the Varnholt Logistics board, announced the decision and described Marrenkamp as "the unanimous choice."

The announcement rests on the company's formal press release, "Board Announces Leadership Succession," issued on 14 March and filed with the regional business registry.

Varnholt Logistics is one of the area's larger employers, and the change in leadership will be watched closely by staff, suppliers and customers across the region.

The company's filing sets out the succession as complete, with Marrenkamp in post from the date of the announcement.
